scope: RenderWare/D3D/presentation object boundary archaeology limited to original engine-facing Graphics/model/mesh handles, Cell object-to-world and model associations, object transforms, visibility/state, scene attachment, and the narrow third-party draw contract. Static SDK/decomp/triage evidence is used; no RenderWare implementation reconstruction, runtime claim, or modern implementation is included.
unresolved: IShadowWorld::AddModelWorld and layer attachment calls are recovered through editor and Cell vtables, but conflict handling, null-service behavior, and runtime detach ordering are not runtime-observed.

No positive Cell-mode runtime trace or original pixel oracle verifies model/world visibility, effect attachment, LOD selection, material bindings, or final transform submission; current OpenSpore counterparts are static mappings only.

The concrete Graphics::IModelManager methods behind the accessor are not characterized; ModelManager should remain a narrow model/content adapter until load identity, cache, and failure behavior are traced.
The exact cCellGFX AddPreloadedTexture container and reference semantics are decompiler-ambiguous; only its call position and relationship to the preload path are reliable.

The original Graphics::cModelWorld::UpdateWithLODMeshes, IModelWorld::LoadModelProperties, and cModelWorld::FinishBackgroundLoad bodies and caller edges are not exported, so LOD selection and background-load semantics remain uncharacterized.
Transform::PreTransformBy has a partially ambiguous thiscall receiver; preserve composed offset, rotation, scale, flags, and count without claiming the original ABI layout.
